translations.marquee.text: Pockai · Your pocket yokai with AI · Hatch · Care · Battle · Chat ·
translations.meta.title: Pockai — Your pocket yokai with AI
translations.meta.description: Pockai is a virtual pet you hatch, care for and raise. It lives on your desktop and your phone, battles in the Arena and talks to you thanks to AI.
translations.nav.label: Main
translations.hero.tagline: Your pocket yokai, with artificial intelligence.
translations.hero.sub: Hatch an egg, care for your creature and help it grow. It lives on your desktop and your phone at the same time.
translations.about.title: What is Pockai
translations.about.lead: Three words in one name: pocket, yokai and AI.
translations.about.pocket.body: Pocket-sized. Your pet keeps you company on the Windows desktop and on Android, always in sync.
translations.about.yokai.body: Creatures with their own rarity, pattern and palette. Every hatch is rolled on the server and no two come out the same.
translations.about.ai.body: With a language model connected, your pockai has a personality: it chats with you, remembers and lends a hand.
translations.features.title: Everything it does
translations.features.lead: A tamagotchi with a lot more inside.
translations.feat.hatch.title: Hatching
translations.feat.hatch.body: Every egg hides a creature with its own rarity, pattern and palette, from normal to mythic. With some luck, even a shiny variant.
translations.feat.care.title: Care
translations.feat.care.body: Hunger, happiness, energy, hygiene and health. Neglect it and it may get sick or sad; look after it and it grows into its final form.
translations.feat.games.title: Minigames
translations.feat.games.body: Catch the Food, Memory Pairs and Reflexes. Playing earns experience and coins for the shop.
translations.feat.arena.title: Arena
translations.feat.arena.body: Asynchronous battles against other players' pets, with elements, skills, animated replays and leagues from Bronze to Mythic.
translations.feat.ai.title: Intelligence
translations.feat.ai.body: Connect your own language model and your pockai chats, remembers what you tell it and acts as a small personal agent.
translations.feat.sync.title: Sync
translations.feat.sync.body: The same pet on desktop and mobile. Link your devices with a code and changes arrive instantly.
translations.species.title: The first pockais
translations.species.lead: The species the game starts with. More are coming.
translations.download.title: Take it along
translations.download.lead: The same pet on all your devices.
translations.download.card.label: Download
translations.plat.windows.body: Your pockai lives on top of your desktop: it walks, sleeps and eats in a transparent window, with a floating chat and native notifications.
translations.plat.android.body: Hatching, care, shop, Arena, minigames and chat. With a home screen widget.
translations.plat.ios.body: The iPhone version is on its way.
translations.faq.title: Questions
translations.faq.1.a: Windows and Android. The iOS version is in development.
translations.faq.2.q: Do I need an API key to play?
translations.faq.2.a: No. The AI part is optional: if you want your pockai to talk, you connect your own API key or a Hermes Agent. Keys are encrypted on the server and the app only shows a mask.
translations.faq.3.q: How do I link desktop and mobile?
translations.faq.3.a: The desktop app shows a six-digit code that you confirm from your phone. From then on both show the same pet.
translations.faq.4.a: No, they are asynchronous. You pick a strategy, the server finds a rival at your level and simulates the battle; afterwards you can watch the animated replay.
translations.faq.5.q: What happens if I neglect my pockai?
translations.faq.5.a: If a stat stays low for too long it may get sick and need healing, or become sad and perform worse in battle.
